title: Why does ice melt?
source_provenance: Generated example; no uploaded school source or teacher approval exists
initial_question: Why does ice melt when left in a warm room?

objectives.title: Explain where the heat comes from
criteria: Identifies warmer surroundings as energy source
Explains energy transfers to colder ice

misconceptions.question: So the ice creates its own heat to melt?
misconceptions.correction: The energy comes from the warmer surroundings.

objectives.title: Explain the change of state
criteria: Describes ice changing from solid water into liquid water
Connects the change with receiving energy

objectives.title: Apply the idea to insulation
criteria: Does not say insulation creates cold

misconceptions.question: Does the container make cold to keep the ice solid?
misconceptions.correction: Insulation slows energy transfer from warmer surroundings.
